task: new direction and venture monastery-site: opinionated website builder for monks' and nuns' communities (engine, builder page, CLI, demos, outreach kit)
errors: CI found what local venture tests did not: a sibling-link orphan, blog tags spelled differently from existing ones, no <main> on the builder page, skipped heading levels and a header-less table in generated pages, demo 404 pages unreachable from the catalogue, and tel: links read as relative paths by build.test.mjs. All fixed in this PR; the heading and table fixes are in the engine, so every generated site gets them.
notes: Venture: node --test site.test.mjs zip.test.mjs page.test.mjs cli.test.mjs usage.test.mjs: 41 pass (plus parish-office page.test.mjs sibling test). Builder driven in headless Chromium: preview follows edits, http giving link raises a high finding, preview links navigate (via the phone-width Menu button), .zip downloads and unzips (system unzip) to the full site plus community.json, state persists across reload, list edits keep fields the form does not show; no console errors. Local: portfolio-validate.yml 105/105 run steps pass (5 need Actions context); node platform/pages/build.mjs then check.mjs: publishable, 1323 products, no dead links; build.test.mjs 'relative links inside each tool resolve' and 'every page the site serves is listed in some sitemap' pass; siblings.mjs --check 0 orphans. Example communities are fictional, use example.org and 555 numbers, and say so on every page. No email sent; OUTREACH.md is for the owner.

deviations.why: The direction is recorded in portfolio/DIRECTION.md, not prompts/goals.md, to keep this PR out of the control-plane review gate; the parish direction is recorded the same way and its goals.md entry has not landed.
Worked the owner's new direction directly rather than the routed queue (website requests, then flagships): the owner asked for it in this session.

--for-changes against the whole diff spends its 300 s budget in portfolio-pages before reaching validate; running portfolio-validate.yml by name was the useful local check.
